faqs.q: How do I remove noise from a photo?

faqs.a: Median filtering replaces each pixel with the middle value of its neighborhood, which deletes isolated bright/dark specks. Gaussian blur averages the neighborhood, which softens everything including real detail.
faqs.q: Median or Gaussian — which is better?

faqs.a: No. Denoising always trades some fine detail for smoothness. Median filters preserve edges far better than blur, but very fine texture can still be lost.
faqs.q: Will denoising keep my photo sharp?

faqs.a: Yes, if it is just sensor grain or scan dust. It cannot recover detail that was never captured, and it cannot fix motion blur or bad focus.

image-denoiser.formula:
median: out(x,y) = median of the (2r+1)² neighborhood values
r = 1 → 3×3 (9 values),  r = 2 → 5×5 (25 values)
gaussian: out = blur(image, σ) via canvas blur filter
howTo: Upload the noisy or grainy photo.
Choose Median 3×3 for light grain, Median 5×5 for heavy specks, or Gaussian for a smooth softening.
Set the number of passes (median) or the blur radius (gaussian).
Compare the preview with your expectations and adjust.
Download the cleaned image as PNG or JPG.
keyFacts: A median filter replaces each pixel with the middle value of its window, deleting isolated noise spikes.
The 3×3 window examines 9 neighbors; the 5×5 window examines 25 for stronger cleaning.
Gaussian mode uses the browser's blur filter with your chosen radius (0.5–4 px).
Running 2–3 median passes cleans stubborn grain progressively.
Images over 2048 px on the long side are processed at 2048 px for speed.

Heavy filtering softens fine texture like hair, fabric weave, and distant foliage.
Large images are capped at 2048 px on the long side during processing.
Motion blur and out-of-focus shots cannot be fixed by noise filters.

image-denoiser.workedExample:
A 3×3 window around a noisy pixel holds values [12, 15, 18, 20, 22, 25, 30, 33, 200]:
sorted → [12, 15, 18, 20, 22, 25, 30, 33, 200]
median (5th of 9) = 22
The isolated bright spike of 200 (salt noise) is replaced by 22, while the true edge values around 20 stay intact.
